I am a Research Data Scientist specializing in epidemiology, longitudinal cohort analysis, and causal inference. My work focuses on data harmonization and advanced statistical methods across multi-center population health cohorts.

## Research Areas:

[Longitudinal Cohort Analytics]{.badge style="background-color: #1B3B2B; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5em 0.8em;"}

[Missing Data Methods]{.badge style="background-color: #1B3B2B; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5em 0.8em;"}

[Causal Inference & Mediation Analysis]{.badge style="background-color: #1B3B2B; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.5em 0.8em;"}
